Description: User can log into Railway with valid username and password
Steps: 1. Navigate to QA Railway Website; 2. Click on Login tab; 3. Enter valid Email and Password; 4. Click on Login button
Expected Behavior: User is logged into Railway. Welcome user message is displayed.

Description: User cannot login with blank username textbox
Steps: 1. Navigate to QA Railway Website; 2. Click on Login tab; 3. Leave Username blank and enter a valid Password; 4. Click on Login button
Expected Behavior: User cannot login and the expected validation message is displayed.
Execution Observation: Actual error message did not contain the trailing space included in the expected text.

Description: User cannot log into Railway with invalid password
Steps: 1. Navigate to QA Railway Website; 2. Click on Login tab; 3. Enter valid Email and invalid Password; 4. Click on Login button
Execution Observation: Actual message was Invalid username or password. Please try again., which differed from the expected form error.

Description: Login page displays when an unauthenticated user clicks Book ticket
Steps: 1. Navigate to QA Railway Website; 2. Click on Book ticket tab
Expected Behavior: Login page displays instead of Book ticket page.

Description: System shows a message after repeated incorrect password attempts
Steps: 1. Navigate to QA Railway Website; 2. Click on Login tab; 3. Enter valid Username and an incorrect Password; 4. Click Login; 5. Repeat incorrect login attempts as specified in the case.
Execution Observation: Actual invalid-credentials message differed from the expected repeated-attempt warning.

Description: Additional pages display once user logged in
Steps: 1. Navigate to QA Railway Website; 2. Click Login; 3. Login with valid account; 4. Verify My ticket, Change password and Logout tabs; 5. Open My ticket and Change password pages
Expected Behavior: My ticket, Change password and Logout tabs are displayed; the corresponding pages can be opened.

Steps: 1. Navigate to QA Railway Website; 2. Click Register; 3. Enter valid information in all fields; 4. Click Register

Description: User cannot login with an account that has not been activated
Steps: Precondition: Create a new account but do not activate it; then navigate to the login page, enter the account details and submit.
Expected Behavior: User cannot login and the expected invalid-credentials message appears.

Steps: Precondition: Create and activate a new account; then login, open Change Password, fill all fields and submit.
Execution Observation: Actual confirmation message contained an exclamation mark not included in the expected text.

Description: User cannot create an account when Confirm password differs from Password
Steps: 1. Navigate to QA Railway Website; 2. Click Register; 3. Enter mismatching Password and Confirm password values; 4. Submit the form.

Description: User cannot create an account while Password and PID fields are empty
Steps: 1. Navigate to QA Railway Website; 2. Click Register; 3. Enter a valid email and leave Password and PID empty; 4. Submit the form.
Expected Behavior: Form-level error and field-level password/PID validation messages appear.
